# Static-Universe-DES-SN5YR — AI-readable index (llms.txt)

> A specified non-expanding (static Euclidean) two-channel photon-propagation
> model tested adversarially against the DES-SN5YR Type Ia supernova release.
> Headline: on the frozen DES-SN5YR v1.2 distance vector the static law fits
> within Δχ² = +1.1 of flat ΛCDM (one shape parameter each); the paper carries
> explicit falsification gates, adverse results included. It challenges the
> inference that SN observations uniquely demonstrate accelerating expansion —
> it does not claim a completed static cosmology.

All URLs below are raw/static and readable without JavaScript.
Raw base: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tracyphasespace/Static-Universe-DES-SN5YR/master/
